name: What happens after a second or third DUI in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: What happens after a second or third DUI in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: Repeat DUI offenders face escalating penalties in San Diego, including longer jail time, increased fines, license revocation, DUI school, and mandatory ignition interlock devices.sandiegodui​
